name: Terrain Chunk Generation
definition: Generates a voxel chunk using two layers of fractal Brownian motion (fBm) noise: one for surface height and one for cave depth. Assigns materials based on vertical distance from the surface and absolute Y position.
summary: Terrain Chunk Generation creates voxel chunks using two fractal Brownian motion noise layers for surface height and cave depth, assigning materials based on vertical distance from the surface.
